title: Advanced Memory Wafer-to-Wafer Bonding with Support of Recyclable Carrier Systems
notes: Three recyclable carrier schemes (A inorganic film/blade, B IR laser release stack, C glass/photonic) for 3-wafer memory W2W stack; Device 1 <2 um; qualitative results, almost no numbers.

title: Game-Changing Nanosolder Technology: Self-Assembling Adhesives for Sub-10 µm Ultra-Fine Interconnects
orgs: Nopion Co.,Ltd; Hanyang University, Department of Mechanical Convergence Engineering; Hanyang University, Department of Mechanical Engineering
notes: Sn nanosolder self-assembling adhesive on Si test chips: bumping at 40/10 um pitch, chip-to-chip bonding at 20/10 um pitch (hot plate ~0 pressure, TCB 0.5/1.0 N); SEM/EDS/XRM, DSC, die shear 20-23 MPa.

title: Novel Temporary Bonding Film and Debonding Method Adapted for the Fabrication Process of Large Size Panel Packages
notes: TBF TM-420 with Xe flash (photonic) debonding on 320 mm and 510x515 mm soda-glass panels; EMC type/thickness/chip splits; warpage after molding; damage-free debond/detape; panel-to-panel bare-glass coupon.
